The catalog is available as python pandas dataframe (pickle), python numpy structured array (pickle), python numpy structured array (.npy, no pickle), json, csv, xlsx, txt, hdf5, html, html with header, and this is the header txt file with comments, references and parameter descriptions.

Here is a a google colab notebook that demonstrates how to work with this and other catalogs on helioforecast.space in python.
Or simply use these lines to import the ICME catalog into python as a pandas dataframe:

import pandas as pd
url='https://helioforecast.space/static/sync/icmecat/HELIO4CAST_ICMECAT_v23.csv'
ic=pd.read_csv(url)
ic.keys()
